title: Compliance & provenance gating for model uploads: license and restricted-weights checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Ship an automated gating layer for model onboarding that enforces license compatibility, flags restricted weights, and records provenance metadata. This gate will run in the model upload flow (Console, API/CLI, and pull-request-based model registry) and block or quarantine models that fail checks. The feature should integrate with Legal/Trust signals and provide a clear remediation/appeal workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Every model upload in Console/API/CLI triggers a license scan that outputs SPDX-compatible license id or flags unknown licenses
Restricted-weights list (maintained by Legal) is used to mark disallowed uploads; disallowed uploads are quarantined and cannot be published to the public catalog
Provenance metadata (source URL, weights checksum, upstream license, training data tags if provided) is captured and persisted on the model entity

Pinning guidance: when a model is accepted, a recommended pinned version string is suggested and stored; downstream serving will default to pinned version unless overridden with explicit risk acknowledgement
Performance profile publishing is gated: only models with a successful lightweight perf-validation run (smoke tests for latency and mem footprint) can be published to the verified catalog
UI/CLI surfaces clear remediation steps and a documented appeal flow that routes to Legal with auto-attached artifacts (license scan report, weight checksum, uploader metadata)
Audit log entries exist for all gate decisions with actor, timestamp, and artifacts
E2E tests and CI checks validate the gating behavior across Console, API, and GitHub PR model-registry flows
out_of_scope: Deep forensics of model weights provenance beyond supplied upstream metadata (this will be a follow-up research project)
Billing or pricing changes related to quarantined models
risks_and_mitigations: False positives from license inference: mitigate by surfacing raw evidence and allow Legal override with justification
Blocked uploads for partner models could slow GTM: provide a fast-track manual review SLA (48h) for commercial partners
Attackers may try to evade provenance checks by altering metadata: validate checksum of uploaded artifacts and store immutable blob references
Performance gating may reject large community models unexpectedly: include a configurable threshold and allow opt-in manual verification
implementation_notes: License scanner component: integrate existing OSS scanner (SPDX-based) and a fallback n-gram matching heuristic for UNKNOWN licenses
Restricted-weights registry: a managed list stored in the private control plane; Legal will own entries and change logs
Model upload flow changes: Console upload modal -> preflight license check; API returns 200 with status:quarantined for disallowed models; CLI shows human-readable remediation
Perf-smoke runner: lightweight runtime on a single GPU with a standard prompt set to measure cold-start latency and peak memory; failures must produce a deterministic report
Catalog metadata schema extension: add fields: provenance_url, weights_checksum, license_spdx, provenance_report_url, pinned_version_recommendation
Default pinning policy doc: recommend pin to {model_name}@{weights_checksum[:8]} unless the uploader chooses semantic versioning and provides release notes
Telemetry: gating rate, quarantined rate, average time-to-review for manual appeals, and downstream serving incidents tied to unpinned models
stakeholders: Engineering: Priya Sharma (backend lead), Diego Alvarez (runtime)
